about_the_game:
Your landlord is knocking on your door. You have one coin left to your name. You insert the coin into your slot machine...and...JACKPOT! Luck be a Landlord, tonight!

Demo Features

  • Roguelite gameplay - The symbols you can add to the slot machine are different every time!
  • 55+ Symbols to add to your slot machine - Each symbol has different effects and interactions.
  • 35+ Items to choose from - The items are different every time as well, leading to interesting build strategies.
  • A terrible landlord to defeat.
  • A dog you can pet.
  • Capitalism.

short_description: Luck be a Landlord is a roguelike deckbuilder about using a slot machine to earn rent money and defeat capitalism. This game does not contain any real-world currency gambling or microtransactions.
